verses.kjv: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.modern: Solomon the son of David established himself in his kingdom. The LORD His God was with Him and magnified Him exceedingly.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
verses.modern: Solomon spoke to all Israel — to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to all the leaders of all Israel, the heads of the fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Solomon and all the assembly with him went to the high place that was at Gibeon, for the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness, was there.

verses.kjv: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: But David had brought the ark of God up from Kiriath-jearim to the place David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.modern: The bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, had made was there before the tent of the LORD. And Solomon and the assembly sought the LORD there.

verses.kjv: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.modern: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

verses.kjv: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.modern: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask what I shall give you."

verses.kjv: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.modern: Solomon said to God, "You have shown great mercy to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

verses.kjv: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.modern: O LORD God, let Your word to David my father be now fulfilled, for you have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.

verses.kjv: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.modern: Give me now wisdom and knowledge to go out and come in before this people, for who can govern this people of Yours, which is so great?"

verses.kjv: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.modern: God answered Solomon, "Because this was in your heart and you have not asked for possessions, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, and have not even asked for long life, but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may govern my people over whom I have made you king,

verses.kjv: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.modern: Wisdom and knowledge are granted to you. I will also give you riches, possessions, and honor, such as none of the kings had who were before you, and none after you shall have the like."

verses.kjv: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
verses.modern: So Solomon came from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting, to Jerusalem. And he reigned over Israel.

verses.kjv: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.modern: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stone. He made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.modern: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from all lands.

verses.kjv: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.modern: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty. Likewise through them these were exported to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.

chapters.summary: Solomon went to the tabernacle at Gibeon and offered a thousand burnt offerings; God appeared to him there and granted his request for wisdom. God also gave Solomon surpassing riches, wealth, and honor.

verses.kjv: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.modern: Now Solomon purposed to build a temple for the name of the LORD and a royal palace for Himself.

verses.kjv: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.modern: Solomon assigned seventy thousand men to bear loads and eighty thousand to quarry in the mountains, with three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

verses.kjv: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.modern: Solomon sent word to Hiram the king of Tyre: "As you dealt with David my father and sent him cedar to build himself a house to live in, so deal with me.

verses.kjv: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
verses.modern: I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God and dedicate it to Him for the burning of incense of sweet spices before Him, and for the regular arrangement of the bread of the Presence, and for burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths and the new moons and the appointed feasts of the LORD our God, as ordained forever for Israel.

verses.kjv: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
verses.modern: The house that I am to build will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

verses.kjv: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.modern: But who is able to build Him a house, since heaven, even highest heaven, cannot contain Him? Who am I to build a house for Him, except as a place to make offerings before Him?

verses.kjv: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.modern: So now send me a man skilled to work in gold, silver, bronze, and iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue fabrics, trained also in engraving, to be with the skilled workers who are with me in Judah and Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

verses.kjv: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.modern: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum timber from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. And my servants will be with your servants,

verses.kjv: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.modern: To prepare timber for me in abundance, for the house I am to build will be great and wonderful.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.modern: I will give for your servants, the woodsmen who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of crushed wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil."

verses.kjv: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.modern: Then Hiram the king of Tyre answered in a letter that he sent to Solomon, "Because the LORD loves His people, He has made You king over them."

verses.kjv: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.modern: Hiram also said, "Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, with insight and understanding, who will build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for Himself.

verses.kjv: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
verses.modern: Now I have sent a skilled man, with understanding, Huram-abi my father's,

verses.kjv: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
verses.modern: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan. His father was a man of Tyre. He is trained to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, and in purple, blue, and crimson fabrics and fine linen, and to do all sorts of engraving and execute any design that may be assigned him, with your craftsmen, the craftsmen of my lord David your father.

verses.kjv: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.modern: Now therefore the wheat and barley, oil and wine, of which my lord has spoken, let him send to his servants.

verses.kjv: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: We will cut whatever timber you need from Lebanon and bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa, so that you may take it up to Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.modern: Then Solomon counted all the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel, after the census of them that David his father had taken, and there were found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.modern: Seventy thousand of them he assigned to bear loads, eighty thousand to quarry in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred as overseers to make the people work.

chapters.summary: Solomon sent word to Hiram king of Tyre requesting skilled craftsmen and timber for the temple. Hiram praised the LORD and sent Huram-abi, a master craftsman, along with the materials.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.modern: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to David his father, at the place David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.modern: He began to build in the second month of the fourth year of His reign.

verses.kjv: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.modern: These are Solomon's foundations for building the house of God. The length, in cubits of the old standard, was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

verses.kjv: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.modern: The vestibule in front of the nave of the house was twenty cubits long, equal to the width of the house, and its height was one hundred twenty cubits. He overlaid it on the inside with pure gold.

verses.kjv: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.modern: The main nave he lined with cypress and covered it with fine gold and made palm trees and chains on it.

verses.kjv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.modern: He also adorned the house with precious stones. The gold was gold of Parvaim.

verses.kjv: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.modern: So he lined the house with gold — the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors — and he carved cherubim on the walls.

verses.kjv: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.modern: He made the most holy place. Its length, corresponding to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits. He overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine gold.

verses.kjv: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.modern: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

verses.kjv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.modern: In the most holy place he made two cherubim of wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.modern: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits: one wing of the first cherub was five cubits, touching the wall of the house, and the other wing was five cubits, touching the wing of the other cherub;

verses.kjv: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.modern: One wing of the other cherub was five cubits, touching the wall of the house, and the other wing was also five cubits, touching the wing of the first cherub.

verses.kjv: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.modern: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. The cherubim stood on their feet, facing the nave.

verses.kjv: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.modern: He made the veil of blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen. He worked cherubim into it.

verses.kjv: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.modern: In front of the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits high, with a capital of five cubits on the top of each.

verses.kjv: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.modern: He made chains like a necklace and put them on the tops of the pillars. He made one hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.

verses.kjv: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.modern: He set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right and one on the left; the one on the right he called Jachin, and the one on the left he called Boaz.

chapters.summary: Solomon began building the temple on Mount Moriah in the fourth year of his reign. The chapter describes the dimensions of the house, the most holy place overlaid with gold, the cherubim, the veil, and the two bronze pillars named Jachin and Boaz.

verses.kjv: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.modern: He made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

verses.kjv: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.modern: Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high. A line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.

verses.kjv: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.modern: Under it was the similitude of oxen encircling it, ten to a cubit, surrounding the sea all around. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

verses.kjv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.modern: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The sea was set on them. All their rear parts were inward.

verses.kjv: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.modern: Its thickness was a handbreadth. And its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held three thousand baths.

verses.kjv: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.modern: He also made ten basins in which to wash, and set five on the right side and five on the left, to rinse off what was used for the burnt offering; the sea was for the priests to wash in.

verses.kjv: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.modern: He made ten golden lampstands as prescribed and set them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.

verses.kjv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.modern: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made one hundred basins of gold.

verses.kjv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.modern: He made the court of the priests and the great court and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.modern: He set the sea at the southeast corner of the house.

verses.kjv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.modern: Hiram also made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of God:

verses.kjv: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.modern: The two pillars, the bowls, and the two capitals on top of the pillars. The two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals on top of the pillars;

verses.kjv: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.modern: Four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework, to cover the two bowls of the capitals on top of the pillars.

verses.kjv: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.modern: He also made the stands and the basins on the stands,

verses.kjv: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.modern: The one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath it;

verses.kjv: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
verses.modern: The pots, the shovels, and the forks — all these utensils Hiram-abi made of burnished bronze for King Solomon for the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.modern: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

verses.kjv: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.modern: Solomon made all these things in great quantities, for the weight of the bronze was not determined.

verses.kjv: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.modern: So Solomon made all the furnishings that were in the house of God: the golden altar, the tables for the bread of the Presence,

verses.kjv: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.modern: The lampstands and their lamps of pure gold to burn before the inner sanctuary as prescribed,

verses.kjv: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.modern: The flowers, the lamps, and the tongs — of purest gold;

verses.kjv: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.modern: The snuffers, basins, dishes for incense, and fire pans — of pure gold. The sockets of the temple, for both the inner doors to the most holy place and the doors of the nave of the temple — of gold.

chapters.summary: Solomon made the bronze altar, the great molten sea resting on twelve oxen, ten lavers, ten golden lampstands, ten tables, and the courts. Huram-abi completed all the bronze and gold furnishings for the house of God.

verses.kjv: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
verses.modern: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated — the silver, the gold, and all the vessels — and put them in the treasuries of the house of God.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.modern: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers' houses of the people of Israel, in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.kjv: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
verses.modern: All the men of Israel assembled before the king at the feast that is in the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.modern: All the elders of Israel came, and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.kjv: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.modern: They brought up the ark, the tent of meeting. All the holy vessels that were in the tent; the priests and the Levites brought them up.

verses.kjv: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.modern: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who had assembled before him, were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.

verses.kjv: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.modern: So the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, underneath the wings of the cherubim.

verses.kjv: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.modern: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, so that the cherubim overshadowed the ark and its poles.

verses.kjv: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.modern: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary. But they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.

verses.kjv: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.modern: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses put there at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the people of Israel when they came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
verses.modern: When the priests came out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves, without regard to their divisions;

verses.kjv: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.modern: All the Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, their sons and kinsmen, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, stood east of the altar with one hundred twenty priests who were trumpeters);

verses.kjv: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;
verses.modern: It was the duty of the trumpeters and singers to make themselves heard in unison in praise and thanksgiving to the LORD — and when the song was raised, with trumpets and cymbals and other musical instruments, in praise to the LORD, "For He is good, for His mercy endures forever," the house of the LORD was filled with a cloud,

verses.kjv: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
verses.modern: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.

chapters.summary: Solomon brought the dedicated treasures of David into the temple, and the priests carried the ark of the covenant into the most holy place. When the trumpeters and singers praised the LORD in unison, the glory of the LORD filled the house as a cloud.

verses.kjv: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.modern: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that He would dwell in thick darkness.

verses.kjv: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.modern: But I have built You a house to dwell in, a place for You to live in forever."

verses.kjv: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.modern: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood.

verses.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.modern: He said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who with His hand has fulfilled what He promised with His mouth to David my father, saying,

verses.kjv: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
verses.modern: 'Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, so that my name might be there. I chose no man as prince over my people Israel;

verses.kjv: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
verses.modern: But I have chosen Jerusalem that my name may be there. I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.'

verses.kjv: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.modern: But the LORD said to David my father, 'Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, it is not You who shall build the house, but Your son who shall be born to You shall build the house for my name.'

verses.kjv: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: The LORD has fulfilled His promise that He made. For I have risen in the place of David my father and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
verses.modern: There I have set the ark, in which is the covenant of the LORD that He made with the people of Israel."

verses.kjv: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
verses.modern: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out His hands.

verses.kjv: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.modern: Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the court. He stood on it. Then he knelt on his knees in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven,

verses.kjv: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.modern: And said: "O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You, in heaven or on earth, keeping covenant and showing mercy to Your servants who walk before You with all their heart;

verses.kjv: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.modern: You who have kept with your servant David my father what you declared to him. You spoke with your mouth, and with your hand have fulfilled it this day.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.modern: Now therefore, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant David my father what you have promised him, saying, 'You shall not lack a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only Your sons pay close attention to their way, to walk in my law as You have walked before me.'

verses.kjv: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
verses.modern: Now therefore, O LORD, God of Israel, let Your word be confirmed, which You have spoken to Your servant David.

verses.kjv: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.modern: But will God indeed dwell with man on the earth? heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain You, how much less this house that I have built!

verses.kjv: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.modern: Yet have regard to the prayer of Your servant and to His plea, O LORD my God, listening to the cry and to the prayer that Your servant prays before You,

verses.kjv: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.modern: That Your eyes may be open day and night toward this house, the place where You have promised to set Your name, that You may listen to the prayer that Your servant offers toward this place.

verses.kjv: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.modern: Listen to the pleas of Your servant and of Your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. And listen from heaven Your dwelling place, and when You hear, forgive.

verses.kjv: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.modern: If a man sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath and comes and swears His oath before Your altar in this house,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.modern: Then hear from heaven and act and judge Your servants, repaying the guilty by bringing His conduct on His own head, and vindicating the righteous by rewarding him according to his righteousness.

verses.kjv: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.modern: If Your people Israel are defeated before the enemy because they have sinned against you. They turn again and acknowledge Your name and pray and plead with You in this house,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.modern: Then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel and bring them back to the land that You gave to them and to their fathers.

verses.kjv: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.modern: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, if they pray toward this place and acknowledge Your name and turn from their sin, when You afflict them,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.modern: Then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, when You teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on Your land, which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.

verses.kjv: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.modern: If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence or blight or mildew or locust or caterpillar, if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land, or whatever plague or whatever sickness there is,

verses.kjv: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.modern: Whatever prayer or plea is made by any man or by all Your people Israel, each knowing His own affliction and His own sorrow and stretching out His hands toward this house,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.modern: Then hear from heaven Your dwelling place and forgive and render to each one whose heart you know — for you, you alone, know the hearts of the children of man —

verses.kjv: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.modern: That they may fear You and walk in Your ways all the days that they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.

verses.kjv: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.modern: Likewise, when a foreigner, who is not of Your people Israel, comes from a far country for the sake of Your great name and Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm, when He comes and prays toward this house,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.modern: Hear from heaven Your dwelling place and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that this house that I have built is called by Your name.

verses.kjv: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.modern: If Your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way You shall send them. They pray to You toward this city that You have chosen and the house that I have built for Your name,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.modern: Then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and maintain their cause.

verses.kjv: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.modern: If they sin against You — for there is no one who does not sin — and you are angry with them and give them to an enemy, so that they are carried away captive to a land far or near,

verses.kjv: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.modern: Yet if they turn their heart in the land to which they have been carried captive and repent and plead with You in the land of their captivity, saying, 'We have sinned and have acted perversely and wickedly,'

verses.kjv: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.modern: If they repent with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity to which they were carried captive, and pray toward their land, which You gave to their fathers, the city that You have chosen, and the house that I have built for Your name,

verses.kjv: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
verses.modern: Then hear from heaven Your dwelling place their prayer and their pleas, and maintain their cause and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.

verses.kjv: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.modern: Now, O my God, let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer of this place.

verses.kjv: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.modern: Now arise, O LORD God, and go to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. Let Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let Your saints rejoice in Your goodness.

verses.kjv: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
verses.modern: O LORD God, do not turn away the face of Your anointed one! Remember Your mercy for David your servant."

chapters.summary: Solomon stood before the altar and prayed his great dedicatory prayer, asking God to hear from heaven whenever His people prayed toward the temple in times of sin, defeat, drought, famine, or captivity.

verses.kjv: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
verses.modern: As soon as Solomon finished his prayer, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

verses.kjv: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's house.
verses.modern: The priests could not enter the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD filled the LORD's house.

verses.kjv: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: When all the people of Israel saw the fire come down and the glory of the LORD on the temple, they bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, "For He is good, for His mercy endures forever."

verses.kjv: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
verses.modern: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.modern: King Solomon offered as a sacrifice twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

verses.kjv: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
verses.modern: The priests stood at their posts; the Levites also, with the instruments for music to the LORD that King David had made for giving thanks to the LORD — for His mercy endures forever — whenever David offered praises by their ministry; opposite them the priests sounded trumpets. All Israel stood.

verses.kjv: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
verses.modern: Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD, for there He offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that Solomon had made could not hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat.

verses.kjv: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
verses.modern: At that time Solomon held the feast for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.modern: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for they had kept the dedication of the altar seven days and the feast seven days.

verses.kjv: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
verses.modern: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month He sent the people away to their homes, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.

verses.kjv: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
verses.modern: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD and the king's house. All that Solomon had planned to do in the house of the LORD and in His own house He successfully accomplished.

verses.kjv: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
verses.modern: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon in the night and said to him: "I have heard Your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.

verses.kjv: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
verses.modern: When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command the locust to devour the land, or send pestilence among my people,

verses.kjv: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.modern: If my people who are called by my name humble themselves, and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land.

verses.kjv: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.modern: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.kjv: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.modern: For now I have chosen and consecrated this house that my name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will be there for all time.

verses.kjv: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
verses.modern: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, doing according to all that I have commanded you and keeping my statutes and my rules,

verses.kjv: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.
verses.modern: Then I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father, saying, 'You shall not lack a man to rule Israel.'

verses.kjv: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.modern: But if you turn aside and forsake my statutes and my commandments that I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

verses.kjv: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
verses.modern: Then I will pluck you up from my land that I have given you, and this house that I have consecrated for my name, I will cast out of my sight. I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

verses.kjv: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
verses.modern: This house that was exalted, everyone passing by will be astonished and say, 'Why has the LORD done thus to this land and to this house?'

verses.kjv: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
verses.modern: Then they will say, 'Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods and worshiped them and served them. Therefore He has brought all this disaster on them.' "

chapters.summary: Fire came down from heaven and consumed the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple. God appeared to Solomon by night and promised to hear prayer from the temple, but warned that disobedience would bring destruction.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
verses.modern: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and His own house,

verses.kjv: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
verses.modern: Solomon rebuilt the cities that Hiram had given to him, and settled the people of Israel in them.

verses.kjv: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.modern: Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.

verses.kjv: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.modern: He built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the store cities that he built in Hamath.

verses.kjv: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.modern: He also built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,

verses.kjv: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.modern: Baalath. All the store cities that Solomon had and all the cities for his chariots and the cities for his horsemen, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

verses.kjv: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
verses.modern: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel,

verses.kjv: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.modern: From their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the people of Israel had not destroyed — these Solomon drafted as forced labor, and so they are to this day.

verses.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.modern: But Solomon did not make the people of Israel servants for his work; they were soldiers. His officers, the commanders of his chariots. His horsemen.

verses.kjv: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.modern: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, two hundred and fifty, who exercised authority over the people.

verses.kjv: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
verses.modern: Solomon brought Pharaoh's daughter up from the city of David to the house that he had built for her, for he said, "My wife shall not live in the house of David king of Israel, for the places to which the ark of the LORD has come are holy."

verses.kjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,
verses.modern: Then Solomon offered up burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD that He had built before the vestibule,

verses.kjv: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.modern: As the duty of each day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the three annual feasts — the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths.

verses.kjv: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.modern: According to the ruling of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, and the Levites for their offices of praise and ministry before the priests as the duty of each day required, and the gatekeepers in their divisions at each gate, for so David the man of God had commanded.

verses.kjv: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.modern: They did not turn aside from what the king had commanded the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasuries.

verses.kjv: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
verses.modern: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out from the day the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.

verses.kjv: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.modern: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the shore of the sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.modern: Hiram sent him by his servants ships and servants familiar with the sea. They went to Ophir together with Solomon's servants and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold and brought it to King Solomon.

chapters.summary: After twenty years of building the temple and his own palace, Solomon rebuilt cities, established forced labor from the remaining Canaanite peoples, and organized the priestly and Levitical divisions for worship.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.modern: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions, with a very great retinue and camels bearing spices and very much gold and precious stones. And when she came to Solomon, she told him all that was on her mind.

verses.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.modern: Solomon answered all her questions. There was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.modern: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

verses.kjv: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.modern: The food of His table, the seating of His officials, the attendance of His servants, their clothing, his cupbearers and their clothing, and His ascent by which He went up to the house of the LORD — there was no more spirit in her.

verses.kjv: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
verses.modern: She said to the king, "The report was true that I heard in my own land of your words and of your wisdom,

verses.kjv: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.modern: But I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes had seen it. And half the greatness of your wisdom was not told me; you surpass the report that I heard.

verses.kjv: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.modern: Happy are your men! Happy are your servants, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.modern: Blessed be the LORD Your God, Who has delighted in You and set You on His throne as king for the LORD Your God! Because Your God loved Israel and would establish them forever, He has made You king over them, that You may execute justice and righteousness."

verses.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
verses.modern: Then she gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices and precious stones. There were no spices such as those that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.modern: Moreover, the servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum wood and precious stones.

verses.kjv: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.modern: The king made from the algum wood steps for the house of the LORD and for the king's palace, lyres also and harps for the singers. There was never seen the like of them before in the land of Judah.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.modern: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked, besides what she had brought to the king. So she turned and went back to her own land with her servants.

verses.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.modern: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

verses.kjv: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.modern: Besides that which the traders and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
verses.modern: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of beaten gold went into each shield.

verses.kjv: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.modern: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.modern: The king also made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with pure gold.

verses.kjv: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
verses.modern: The throne had six steps and a footstool of gold, which were attached to the throne, and on each side of the seat were armrests and two lions standing beside the armrests,

verses.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.modern: While twelve lions stood there, one on each end of a step on the six steps. Nothing like it was ever made for any kingdom.

verses.kjv: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.modern: All King Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold. All the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.

verses.kjv: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.modern: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once every three years the ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.modern: Thus King Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

verses.kjv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
verses.modern: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put into his mind.

verses.kjv: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.modern: Every one of them brought his present: articles of silver and of gold, garments, myrrh, spices, horses, and mules, so much year by year.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.modern: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.modern: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stone, and cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.

verses.kjv: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.modern: Horses were imported for Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, from first to last, are they not written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

verses.kjv: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.modern: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

verses.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

chapters.summary: The queen of Sheba visited Solomon and was overwhelmed by his wisdom and splendor. The chapter records Solomon’s immense wealth, his throne of ivory and gold, and his death after forty years of reign.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
verses.modern: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.modern: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it — for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon — then Jeroboam returned from Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.modern: They sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.kjv: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
verses.modern: "Your father made our yoke heavy. Now therefore lighten the hard service of your father and his heavy yoke that he put on us. We will serve you."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Come to me again in three days." So the people went away.

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.modern: Then King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he was yet alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answer this people?"

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.modern: They said to him, "If you will be kind to this people and please them and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever."

verses.kjv: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.
verses.modern: But he abandoned the counsel that the old men gave him and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
verses.modern: He said to them, "What do you advise that we answer this people who have said to me, 'Lighten the yoke that your father put on us'?"

verses.kjv: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.modern: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, "Thus shall you speak to the people who said to you, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, but you lighten it for us.' Thus shall you say to them: 'My little finger is thicker than my father's thigh.

verses.kjv: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.modern: Now, whereas my father laid on you a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips. But I will discipline you with scorpions.' "

verses.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.modern: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had said, "Come to me again the third day."

verses.kjv: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.modern: The king answered them harshly. King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men

verses.kjv: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.modern: Answered them as the young men had advised him, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy. But I will add to it. My father disciplined you with whips. But I will discipline you with scorpions."

verses.kjv: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.modern: So the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn of affairs brought about by God that the LORD might fulfill His word, which He spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.kjv: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
verses.modern: When all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, "What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Each of you to your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, David." So all Israel went to their tents.

verses.kjv: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.modern: But Rehoboam reigned over the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was taskmaster over the forced labor, and the people of Israel stoned him to death with stones. And King Rehoboam quickly mounted his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.modern: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

chapters.summary: Rehoboam went to Shechem where all Israel asked him to lighten the heavy yoke of Solomon; he rejected the elders’ counsel and followed the young men’s harsh advice. The ten northern tribes refused his rule, and Israel was divided.

verses.kjv: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.modern: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen warriors, to fight against Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.

verses.kjv: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.modern: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:

verses.kjv: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.modern: "Say to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.modern: 'Thus says the LORD, You shall not go up or fight against Your brothers. Return every man to his home, for this thing is from me.' " So they listened to the word of the LORD and returned and did not go against Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.modern: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem. He built cities for defense in Judah.

verses.kjv: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
