verses.modern: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

verses.kjv: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.modern: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,

verses.kjv: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.modern: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

verses.kjv: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.modern: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

verses.kjv: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.modern: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron — fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.modern: He made the fortresses strong, and put commanders in them, and stores of food, oil, and wine.

verses.kjv: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.modern: He put shields and spears in all the cities and made them very strong. So he held Judah and Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.modern: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel presented themselves to him from all their territories.

verses.kjv: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
verses.modern: For the Levites left their common lands and their holdings and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out from serving as priests of the LORD,

verses.kjv: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.modern: He appointed His own priests for the high places and for the devils and for the calves that He had made.

verses.kjv: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.modern: Those who had set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came after them from all the tribes of Israel to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

verses.kjv: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.modern: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and for three years they made Rehoboam the son of Solomon secure, for they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.modern: Rehoboam took as his wife Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse,

verses.kjv: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.modern: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

verses.kjv: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.modern: After her he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.modern: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines — he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines and begat twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.modern: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

verses.kjv: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.modern: He dealt wisely and distributed some of his sons throughout all the districts of Judah and Benjamin, in all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and procured many wives for them.

chapters.summary: God through the prophet Shemaiah forbade Rehoboam from fighting to reclaim the northern tribes. Rehoboam fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and Levites from the north came south because Jeroboam had rejected them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
verses.modern: When the rule of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the law of the LORD, and all Israel with Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
verses.modern: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem

verses.kjv: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
verses.modern: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. And the people were without number who came with him from Egypt — Libyans, Sukkiim, and Ethiopians.

verses.kjv: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: He took the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.modern: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, "Thus says the LORD, 'You abandoned me, so I have abandoned You to the hand of Shishak.' "

verses.kjv: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
verses.modern: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The LORD is righteous."

verses.kjv: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.modern: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah: "They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them. But I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, they shall be servants to Him, that they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries."

verses.kjv: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.modern: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem. He took away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house. He took everything. He also took away the shields of gold that Solomon had made.

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam made shields of brass instead of them, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
verses.modern: King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

verses.kjv: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
verses.modern: As often as the king went into the house of the LORD, the guard came and carried them and brought them back to the guardroom.

verses.kjv: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
verses.modern: When He humbled Himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from Him, so as not to make a complete destruction. Moreover, conditions were good in Judah.

verses.kjv: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.modern: So King Rehoboam grew strong in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.

verses.kjv: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.
verses.modern: He did evil, for He did not set His heart to seek the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.modern: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer? There were continual wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David, and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

chapters.summary: When Rehoboam was established, he and all Israel abandoned the law of the LORD. Shishak king of Egypt invaded with a vast army; the LORD humbled Rehoboam, who repented, so God granted partial deliverance but Judah became Egypt’s vassal.

verses.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
verses.modern: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

verses.kjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.modern: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
verses.modern: Abijah went into battle with an army of valiant warriors, four hundred thousand chosen men. And Jeroboam drew up his line of battle against him with eight hundred thousand chosen mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
verses.modern: Then Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim that is in the hill country of Ephraim and said, "Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel!

verses.kjv: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.modern: Ought You not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingship over Israel forever to David and his sons by a covenant of salt?

verses.kjv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
verses.modern: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his lord,

verses.kjv: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.modern: Certain worthless scoundrels gathered around him and defied Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and irresolute and could not resist them.

verses.kjv: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.modern: Now You think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David, because you are a great crowd and have with You the golden calves that Jeroboam made you for gods.

verses.kjv: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
verses.modern: Have You not driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves like the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes for consecration with a young bull or seven rams becomes a priest of what are not gods.

verses.kjv: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
verses.modern: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him. We have priests ministering to the LORD Who are sons of Aaron, and Levites for their service.

verses.kjv: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
verses.modern: They offer to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and incense of sweet spices, set out the bread of the Presence on the pure table, and care for the golden lampstand that its lamps may burn every evening. For we keep the charge of the LORD our God, but You have forsaken Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
verses.modern: God is with us at our head, and His priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against You. O sons of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of Your fathers, for You cannot succeed."

verses.kjv: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.modern: Jeroboam had sent an ambush around to come at them from behind. Thus his troops were in front of Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

verses.kjv: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.modern: When Judah looked, the battle was in front of and behind them. And they cried to the LORD, and the priests blew the trumpets.

verses.kjv: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.modern: Then the men of Judah raised the battle shout. And when the men of Judah shouted, God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.modern: The people of Israel fled before Judah. God gave them into their hand.

verses.kjv: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.modern: Abijah and his people struck them with a great blow, so there fell slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

verses.kjv: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.modern: Thus the people of Israel were subdued at that time, and the people of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.

verses.kjv: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.
verses.modern: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured cities from him, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

verses.kjv: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
verses.modern: Jeroboam did not recover his power in the days of Abijah. And the LORD struck Him down. He died.

verses.kjv: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.modern: But Abijah grew mighty. And He took fourteen wives and begat twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.modern: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

chapters.summary: Abijah king of Judah went to war against Jeroboam of Israel with an army half the size. Abijah rebuked Israel for forsaking the LORD and the Levitical priesthood; God struck Jeroboam’s forces, and Judah won a great victory.

verses.kjv: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.modern: So Abijah slept with his fathers. They buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land had rest for ten years.

verses.kjv: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
verses.modern: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD His God.

verses.kjv: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
verses.modern: He removed the foreign altars and the high places and broke down the pillars and cut down the groves.

verses.kjv: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.modern: Commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to keep the law and the commandment.

verses.kjv: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.modern: He also removed from all the cities of Judah the high places and the incense altars. And the kingdom had rest under Him.

verses.kjv: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
verses.modern: He built fortified cities in Judah, for the land had rest. He had no war in those years, for the LORD gave Him peace.

verses.kjv: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.modern: He said to Judah, "Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him. He has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.

verses.kjv: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.modern: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand from Judah, armed with large shields and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand men from Benjamin who carried small shields and drew the bow. All these were mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
verses.modern: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million men and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.

verses.kjv: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.modern: Asa went out to meet him. They drew up their lines of battle in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

verses.kjv: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let no man prevail against thee.
verses.modern: Asa cried to the LORD His God, "O LORD, there is none like You to help, between the mighty and the weak. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this crowd. O LORD, You are our God; let not man prevail against You."

verses.kjv: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.modern: So the LORD defeated the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah, and the Ethiopians fled.

verses.kjv: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
verses.modern: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them as far as Gerar, and the Ethiopians fell until none remained alive, for they were broken before the LORD and His army. The men of Judah carried away very much spoil.

verses.kjv: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
verses.modern: They attacked all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD was upon them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

verses.kjv: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: They also struck down the tents of those who had livestock and carried away sheep in abundance and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

chapters.summary: Asa did what was good and right, removing foreign altars and high places and commanding Judah to seek the LORD. When Zerah the Ethiopian came against him with a million men, Asa cried out to the LORD and God routed the Ethiopians.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.modern: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded,

verses.kjv: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.modern: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Hear me, Asa. All Judah and Benjamin: The LORD is with You while You are with Him. If You seek Him, He will be found by You, but if You forsake Him, He will forsake You.

verses.kjv: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.modern: For a long time Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest and without law,

verses.kjv: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.modern: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, He was found by them.

verses.kjv: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.modern: In those times there was no peace to Him who went out or to Him who came in, for great disturbances afflicted all the inhabitants of the lands.

verses.kjv: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
verses.modern: They were broken in pieces. Nation was crushed by nation and city by city, for God troubled them with every sort of distress.

verses.kjv: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.modern: But You, take courage! Do not let Your hands be weak, for Your work shall be rewarded."

verses.kjv: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
verses.modern: When Asa heard these words, the prophecy of Azariah the son of Oded the prophet, he took courage and put away the detestable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities that He had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the LORD that was in front of the vestibule of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
verses.modern: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who were living with them, for great numbers had deserted to Him from Israel when they saw that the LORD His God was with Him.

verses.kjv: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.modern: They were gathered at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.kjv: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.modern: They sacrificed to the LORD on that day from the spoil that they had brought — seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

verses.kjv: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of Israel with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.modern: They entered into a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul,

verses.kjv: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.modern: But that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.

verses.kjv: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.modern: They swore an oath to the LORD with a loud voice and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns.

verses.kjv: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
verses.modern: All Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and had sought Him with their whole desire. And He was found by them. The LORD gave them rest all around.

verses.kjv: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.modern: Even Maachah the mother of King Asa, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove. Asa cut down her idol and stamped it and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

verses.kjv: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.modern: But the high places were not taken out of Israel. Nevertheless, the heart of Asa was wholly true all his days.

verses.kjv: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.modern: He brought into the house of God the sacred gifts of His father and His own sacred gifts — silver, gold, and vessels.

verses.kjv: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.modern: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.

chapters.summary: The prophet Azariah met Asa and told him the LORD would be with Judah as long as they sought Him. Asa took courage, removed the idols, repaired the altar of the LORD, and the people entered a covenant to seek God with all their heart.

verses.kjv: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.modern: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and built Ramah, that he might permit no one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.modern: Then Asa took silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the king's house and sent them to Ben-hadad king of Syria, who lived in Damascus, saying,

verses.kjv: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.modern: "There is a covenant between me and You, as there was between my father and Your father. I am sending You silver and gold. Go, break Your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, that He may withdraw from me."

verses.kjv: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.modern: Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel. They struck Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.modern: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah and put an end to his work.

verses.kjv: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.modern: Then King Asa took all Judah. They carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber with which Baasha had been building, and with them he built Geba and Mizpah.

verses.kjv: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
verses.modern: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, "Because you relied on the king of Syria, and did not rely on the LORD Your God, the army of the king of Syria has escaped you.

verses.kjv: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.
verses.modern: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge army with very many chariots and horsemen? Yet because You relied on the LORD, He gave them into Your hand.

verses.kjv: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.modern: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to give strong support to those whose heart is wholly His. You have done foolishly in this, for from now on You will have wars."

verses.kjv: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.modern: Then Asa was angry with the seer and put him in the stocks in prison, for he was in a rage with him because of this. And Asa inflicted cruelties on some of the people at the same time.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.modern: The acts of Asa, from first to last, are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.kjv: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
verses.modern: In the thirty-ninth year of His reign Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease became severe. Yet even in His disease He did not seek the LORD, but sought help from physicians.

verses.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.modern: Asa slept with his fathers and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

verses.kjv: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.modern: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut for himself in the city of David. They laid him on a bier that had been filled with various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumer's art. They made a very great fire in his honor.

chapters.summary: In his later years Asa made an alliance with Ben-hadad of Syria against Baasha of Israel instead of relying on the LORD. The seer Hanani rebuked him; Asa was angry and imprisoned the prophet, and he died with a disease in his feet.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place and strengthened himself against Israel.

verses.kjv: He placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.modern: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa his father had captured.

verses.kjv: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.modern: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of His father David. He did not seek the Baals,

verses.kjv: But sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.modern: But sought the God of His father and walked in His commandments, and not according to the practices of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.modern: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in His hand. And all Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat. He had great riches and honor.

verses.kjv: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
verses.modern: His heart was courageous in the ways of the LORD. And furthermore, He removed the high places and the groves from Judah.

verses.kjv: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah:
verses.modern: In the third year of His reign He sent His officials, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

verses.kjv: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.modern: With them the Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah the Levites. With them Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

verses.kjv: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
verses.modern: They taught in Judah, having the Book of the Law of the LORD with them. They went throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

verses.kjv: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah. They made no war against Jehoshaphat.

verses.kjv: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.modern: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute, and the Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat grew steadily greater. He built in Judah fortresses and store cities,

verses.kjv: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: He had large supplies in the cities of Judah. He had soldiers, mighty warriors, in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.modern: This was the muster of them by fathers' houses: From Judah, the commanders of thousands — Adnah the commander, with three hundred thousand mighty warriors;

verses.kjv: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.modern: Next to him Jehohanan the commander, with two hundred eighty thousand;

verses.kjv: And next to him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.modern: Next to Him Amasiah the son of Zichri, a volunteer for the service of the LORD, with two hundred thousand mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.modern: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty warrior, with two hundred thousand men armed with bow and shield;

verses.kjv: And next to him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.modern: Next to Him Jehozabad, with one hundred eighty thousand equipped for war.

verses.kjv: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
verses.modern: These were in the service of the king, besides those whom the king had placed in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

chapters.summary: Jehoshaphat strengthened himself against Israel and walked in the ways of the LORD. He sent officials and Levites throughout Judah to teach the people the law, and the fear of the LORD fell on the surrounding kingdoms.

verses.kjv: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.modern: Now Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor. He made a marriage alliance with Ahab.

verses.kjv: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
verses.modern: After some years he went down to Ahab in Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance and for the people who were with him, and induced him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.

verses.kjv: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
verses.modern: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead?" He answered him, "I am as you are, my people as your people. We will be with you in the war."

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Inquire first for the word of the LORD."

verses.kjv: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.modern: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, for God will give it into the hand of the king."

verses.kjv: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.modern: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here another prophet of the LORD of whom we may inquire?"

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.modern: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate Him, for He never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say so."

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.modern: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah."

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.modern: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting on their thrones, arrayed in their robes. And they were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria. All the prophets were prophesying before them.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.modern: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said, "Thus says the LORD, 'With these You shall push the Syrians until they are destroyed.' "

verses.kjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.modern: All the prophets prophesied so and said, "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph. The LORD will give it into the hand of the king."

verses.kjv: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
verses.modern: The messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, " the words of the prophets with one accord are favorable to the king. Let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak favorably."

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
verses.modern: But Micaiah said, "As the LORD lives, what my God says, that I will speak."

verses.kjv: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.modern: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I refrain?" And he said, "Go up and triumph. They will be given into your hand."

verses.kjv: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?
verses.modern: But the king said to him, "How many times shall I make You swear that You speak to me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?"

verses.kjv: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.modern: He said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And the LORD said, 'These have no master; let each return to His home in peace.' "

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.modern: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"

verses.kjv: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.modern: Micaiah said, "Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne. All the host of heaven standing on His right hand and on His left.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.modern: The LORD said, 'Who will entice Ahab the king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?' And one said one thing and another said another.

verses.kjv: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?
verses.modern: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the LORD, saying, 'I will entice Him.' And the LORD said to Him, 'By what means?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the LORD said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
verses.modern: He said, 'I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all His prophets.' And He said, 'You are to entice Him, and You shall succeed; go out and do so.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.
verses.modern: Now therefore the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these Your prophets. The LORD has declared disaster concerning You."

verses.kjv: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.modern: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek and said, "Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go from me to speak to You?"

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.modern: Micaiah said, " you shall see on that day when You go into an inner chamber to hide Yourself."

verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.modern: The king of Israel said, "Seize Micaiah and take him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son,

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
verses.modern: Say, 'Thus says the king, Put this man in prison and feed him with meager rations of bread and water until I return in peace.' "

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
verses.modern: Micaiah said, "If You return in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me." And He said, "Hear, all You peoples!"

verses.kjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.modern: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
verses.modern: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself. They went into battle.

verses.kjv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.modern: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, "Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
verses.modern: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, "It is the king of Israel." So they turned to fight against Him. And Jehoshaphat cried out. The LORD helped Him; God drew them away from Him.

verses.kjv: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
verses.modern: For as soon as the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.kjv: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.modern: But a certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the scale armor and the breastplate. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am wounded."

verses.kjv: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
verses.modern: The battle continued that day, and the king of Israel was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians until evening. Then at sunset he died.

chapters.summary: Jehoshaphat allied with Ahab to attack Ramoth-gilead, despite the warning of the prophet Micaiah that the LORD had decreed Ahab’s defeat. Ahab disguised himself in battle but was struck by a random arrow and died.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned in safety to his house in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.
verses.modern: But Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, wrath has gone out against You from the LORD.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, some good is found in You, for You cut down the groves out of the land and have set Your heart to seek God."

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem. And he went out again among the people, from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

verses.kjv: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
verses.modern: He appointed judges in the land in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

verses.kjv: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.
verses.modern: Said to the judges, "Consider what You do, for You judge not for man but for the LORD. He is with You in giving judgment.

verses.kjv: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
verses.modern: Now then, let the fear of the LORD be upon You. Be careful what You do, for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, or respect of persons, or taking of gifts."

verses.kjv: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Moreover, in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites and priests and heads of fathers' houses of Israel, to give judgment for the LORD and to decide disputed cases. They had their seat at Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
verses.modern: He charged them: "Thus You shall do in the fear of the LORD, in faithfulness and with Your whole heart:

verses.kjv: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
verses.modern: Whenever a case comes to You from Your brothers who live in their cities, concerning bloodshed, law or commandment, statutes or rules, You shall warn them, that they may not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath may not come upon You and Your brothers. Thus You shall do, and You will not incur guilt.

verses.kjv: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.
verses.modern: Amariah the chief priest is over You in all matters of the LORD, and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters. The Levites will serve you as officers. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the upright!"

chapters.summary: The seer Jehu rebuked Jehoshaphat for helping Ahab, but acknowledged good in him. Jehoshaphat appointed judges throughout Judah and in Jerusalem, charging them to judge faithfully in the fear of the LORD.

verses.kjv: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.modern: After this the Moabites and Ammonites, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat for battle.

verses.kjv: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
verses.modern: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, "A great crowd is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the sea. They are in Hazazon-tamar" (that is, En-gedi).

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
verses.modern: Then Jehoshaphat was afraid and set his face to seek the LORD and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

verses.kjv: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
verses.modern: Judah assembled to seek help from the LORD; from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

verses.kjv: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
verses.modern: Said, "O LORD, God of our fathers, are You not God in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. In your hand are power and might, so that none is able to withstand You.

verses.kjv: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
verses.modern: Did you not, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?

verses.kjv: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
verses.modern: They have lived in it and have built for you in it a sanctuary for your name, saying,

verses.kjv: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
verses.modern: 'If disaster comes upon us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house and before you — for your name is in this house — and cry out to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.'

verses.kjv: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.modern: Now the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came from the land of Egypt, and whom they avoided and did not destroy —

verses.kjv: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
verses.modern: They reward us by coming to drive us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

verses.kjv: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
verses.modern: O our God, will you not execute judgment on them? For we are powerless against this great horde that is coming against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you."

verses.kjv: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.modern: Meanwhile all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

verses.kjv: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
verses.modern: The Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the midst of the assembly.

verses.kjv: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.
verses.modern: He said, "Listen, all Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Jehoshaphat: Thus says the LORD to You, 'Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed at this great horde, for the battle is not Yours but God's.

verses.kjv: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.modern: Tomorrow go down against them. They will come up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, east of the wilderness of Jeruel.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
verses.modern: You will not need to fight in this battle. Stand firm, hold Your position, and see the salvation of the LORD on Your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out against them. The LORD will be with You.' "

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.
verses.modern: Then Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
verses.modern: The Levites, of the Kohathites and the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.

verses.kjv: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
verses.modern: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. And when they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Hear me, Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD Your God, and You will be established; believe His prophets, and You will succeed."

verses.kjv: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: When He had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and praise Him in holy attire, as they went before the army, and say, "Give thanks to the LORD, for His mercy endures forever."

verses.kjv: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
verses.modern: When they began to sing and praise, the LORD set an ambush against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah, so that they were routed.

verses.kjv: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.modern: For the men of Ammon and Moab rose against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction, and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they all helped to destroy one another.

verses.kjv: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.modern: When Judah came to the watchtower of the wilderness, they looked toward the horde, and there were dead bodies lying on the ground; none had escaped.

verses.kjv: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.modern: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their spoil, they found among them, in great amounts, goods, clothing, and precious things, which they took for themselves until they could carry no more. They were three days in taking the spoil, it was so much.

verses.kjv: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.modern: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, for there they blessed the LORD. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Beracah to this day.

verses.kjv: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy: for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.modern: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat at their head, returned to Jerusalem with joy, for the LORD had made them rejoice over their enemies.

verses.kjv: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: They came to Jerusalem with harps and lyres and trumpets, to the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.modern: The fear of God came on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.

verses.kjv: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
verses.modern: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.modern: Thus Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.kjv: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.modern: He walked in the way of Asa his father and did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
verses.modern: The high places, however, were not taken away; the people had not yet set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, from first to last, are written in the chronicles of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
verses.modern: After this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined with Ahaziah king of Israel, who acted wickedly.

verses.kjv: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.
verses.modern: He joined him in building ships to go to Tarshish. They built the ships in Ezion-geber.

verses.kjv: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.modern: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have joined with Ahaziah, the LORD will destroy what You have made." And the ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish.

chapters.summary: The Moabites, Ammonites, and Meunites invaded Judah; Jehoshaphat proclaimed a fast and prayed before all the people. The LORD told them the battle was His; Judah went out singing praise, and God set the invaders against one another so that none escaped.

verses.kjv: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.modern: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.

verses.kjv: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.modern: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, gold, and valuable possessions, together with fortified cities in Judah. But he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

verses.kjv: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
verses.modern: When Jehoram had ascended the throne of his father and had established himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.modern: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. And he did what was evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.modern: Yet the LORD was not willing to destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and since he had promised to give a lamp to Him and to His sons forever.

verses.kjv: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
verses.modern: In His days Edom revolted from the rule of Judah and set up a king of their own.

verses.kjv: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.modern: Then Jehoram passed over with His commanders and all his chariots. And He rose by night and struck the Edomites who had surrounded Him and his chariot commanders.

verses.kjv: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
verses.modern: So Edom revolted from the rule of Judah to this day. At that time Libnah also revolted from His rule, because He had forsaken the LORD, the God of His fathers.

verses.kjv: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
verses.modern: Moreover, He made high places in the hill country of Judah and led the inhabitants of Jerusalem into whoredom and made Judah go astray.

verses.kjv: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.modern: A letter came to Him from Elijah the prophet, saying, "Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father, 'Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, or in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

verses.kjv: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
verses.modern: But have walked in the way of the kings of Israel and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem go astray, as the house of Ahab led Israel astray, and also you have killed your brothers, of your father's house, who were better than you,

verses.kjv: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.modern: The LORD will bring a great plague on Your people, Your children, Your wives. All Your possessions,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.modern: You Yourself will have a severe sickness with a disease of Your bowels, until Your bowels come out because of the disease, day by day.' "

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.modern: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the anger of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are near the Ethiopians.

verses.kjv: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.modern: They came up against Judah and invaded it and carried away all the possessions they found that belonged to the king's house, and also his sons and his wives, so that no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest son.

verses.kjv: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.modern: After all this the LORD struck Him in His bowels with an incurable disease.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.modern: In the course of time, at the end of two years, His bowels came out because of the disease. He died in great agony. His people made no fire in His honor, like the fires made for His fathers.

verses.kjv: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.modern: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed with no one's regret. They buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

chapters.summary: Jehoram killed all his brothers and reigned wickedly, walking in the ways of the house of Ahab. A letter from Elijah prophesied disaster; the Philistines and Arabians invaded, and Jehoram died of a terrible disease with no one’s regret.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
verses.modern: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

verses.kjv: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.modern: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.

verses.kjv: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.modern: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in doing wickedly.

verses.kjv: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.modern: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done. For after the death of his father they were His counselors, to His undoing.

verses.kjv: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.modern: He even followed their counsel and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to make war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead. And the Syrians wounded Joram.

verses.kjv: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.modern: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds that he had received at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.kjv: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.modern: But it was ordained by God that the downfall of Ahaziah should come about through His going to visit Joram. For when He came there, He went out with Jehoram to meet Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.modern: When Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he met the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brothers, who attended Ahaziah. He killed them.
